messages:
noah: Heads-up: product plans to remove legacy auth header `X-Old-Api-Key` from Partner API. Target enforcement 2025-07-20. Need partner communication + marketplace changelog.

lia: Do we have a soft-compat plan? some marketplace apps still import old SDKs.

omar: We can ship a "compat" SDK release that accepts both headers and emits a console warning for one minor release. Versioning thought: 4.0.1-compat.

pat (partner-ops): I'll prepare partner contact mapping and preferred maintenance windows. Also recommend a pilot with 2 marketplace partners + 1 SI.

ci-bot: Canary ticket created: partners/auth-dep-canary -> due 2025-06-15.

noah: Draft messaging: public: "security header standardization"; partner email: explicit migration timeline + sample code. Lia, can you handle the marketplace copy?

lia: Yup, I'll draft short listing blurb + an FAQ card. We'll avoid the word "breaking" in public.

omar: Migration snippet for docs:
```
# old
X-Old-Api-Key: token
# new
Authorization: Bearer token
```
Include curl/node/python samples.

pat (partner-ops): Action items: 1) I'll export partner list by Mon. 2) Omar publishes compat SDK by next Wed. 3) Lia drafts marketplace copy by Thu. 4) Noah to run pilot selection.

noah: Meeting Friday 9a PT to sign off. If partners request more time we can offer a 30-day extension on a case-by-case basis.
